description: Revoke a team's access to a Sentry project. Returns the project's remaining teams. Refuses to remove the project's last team.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: remove_team_from_project
title: Remove Team from Project
